class Hook:
 def __get__(self,obj,owner):
  print(type(obj).__name__,owner.__name__)
  return write
def write(obj,value): obj.saved=value
class Base: __set__=Hook()
class D(Base): pass
d=D()
d.__set__=None
class A: x=d
a=A()
a.x=7
print(a.saved)

def write(obj,value): obj.saved=value
class D: pass
class A: x=D()
a=A()
a.x=1
D.__set__=property(lambda self: write)
a.x=7
print(a.x,a.saved)
del D.__set__
a.x=9
print(a.x,a.saved)

def write(obj,value):
 obj.saved=value
 return 99
def erase(obj):
 obj.saved=0
 return 99
class D:
 __set__=property(lambda self: write)
 __delete__=property(lambda self: erase)
class A: x=D()
a=A()
print(setattr(a,"x",7),a.saved)
print(delattr(a,"x"),a.saved)
print(object.__setattr__(a,"x",8),a.saved)
print(object.__delattr__(a,"x"),a.saved)
